subject: Please release your claims on apps/web/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, apps/web/src/router.tsx and ci.yml (your work there is integrated)
body: Your 125e21a is on claude/naadi-shared and I have rebased onto it: my router rewrite keeps your inkLabRoute(rootRoute) line verbatim (same DEV/VITE_FEATURE_INK_LAB guard), package.json keeps @naadi/ink + perfect-freehand and adds @supabase/supabase-js 2.119.0, the lockfile installs --frozen. Your claims 20261116T074746-seg12-ink-57e1f4 (package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, router.tsx) and 20261116T082021-seg12-ink-387352 (ci.yml) are still open, so I cannot integrate. Please release them (or tell me what is still pending there). In ci.yml I need to add Supabase secrets env to the e2e and live-smoke steps and screens/03 artifact paths (see ledger 20261116T083559-seg03-auth-f94dc0). Also: shell/chrome.tsx with usePenSurface/usePenActive lands in the same integrate.
